# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

## Before asking for help

Read the [documentation index](../docs/README.md), especially Kaggle setup, reproducibility, troubleshooting, and known limitations. Run `make verify` for repository problems and `production/readiness.sh` for runtime readiness problems.

## Good support requests

Include:

- Kaggle GPU type/count and relevant runtime versions;
- exact command used;
- concise error output;
- affected repository/evidence path;
- whether the result differs from the retained qualified baseline;
- steps already attempted.

Never include access tokens, passwords, private URLs, personal data, or non-consensual voice recordings.

## Scope

Support is best-effort and focused on this repository's qualified Kaggle T4x2 baseline. Upstream model behavior or third-party runtime bugs may need to be handled by their respective projects.
